rules: Participation is free and no purchase is required.
Participants must be at least 18 years old.
The available prize payout methods are bKash or Nagad.
Matches are played on a 6x8 grid. The ball starts at the center (3,4).
Players move the ball to any of the eight adjacent points. Lines cannot be repeated.
Hitting a border or a previously visited point counts as a bounce and grants another move to the same player.
A goal is scored when the ball enters the opponent's goal at the top or bottom edge.
If a player moves the ball to a point from which there are no possible moves, that player immediately loses.
Each player has a 5-minute chess clock. Time runs only during your turn. Running out of time results in a loss.
If a player's phone disconnects before their turn begins, the backend will automatically start their clock after one minute.
Leaving the match early forfeits the game to the opponent.
Tournaments run in a round-robin format. Pairings are generated automatically once registration closes.
Stale matches with no activity for over five minutes are automatically decided on time.
The tournament ends when the deadline is reached.
